property_summary: For every admissible caller and ticket payment, the reference contract either leaves pot increased by TICKET_AMOUNT or resets it to 0 depending on its internal randomness; in particular, there exists an admissible caller/payment where the mutant (which always resets pot) makes pot==0 while the reference can leave pot non-zero — so: after a single valid play call from any caller sending exactly TICKET_AMOUNT, the reference's pot is either previous pot+TICKET_AMOUNT or 0, but it is NOT forced to be 0 for all inputs (the mutant forces 0); the test asserts that there exists an admissible single-play scenario where pot != 0 for the reference (i.e., the reference may keep the pot after play) which the mutant will violate for some fuzz input.
change_summary: Change the condition so transfer path always executes (replace if (random == 0) with if (true)), causing pot to be reset every successful play.
